top_signals.title: Hurricane Isaias Nears Major Status Ahead of Gulf Coast Landfall
top_signals.summary:
Hurricane Isaias is gathering strength Thursday morning despite persistent crosswinds, raising the threat of damaging winds and flooding across a wide stretch of the US Gulf Coast.
Bloomberg Meteorologist Craig Allen details what to expect as the storm makes landfall. (Source: Bloomberg)
